title: EviGraph FinQA 30 Open BM25 GPT-5.4 Direct RAG Prompt Pilot
limitations: This manifest is a 30-example spend-controlled prompt pilot before running a full 300-example GPT-5.4 Direct RAG baseline.
The model id is set to gpt-5.4. If the selected API provider does not support that exact id, update configs/default_gpt54_llm_direct_rag.yaml or use the provider's exact model id.
The 30 examples are sampled deterministically from data/raw/finqa_300_subset.jsonl with seed 13 and require source_doc coverage against data/finqa_300_corpus.
The baseline uses retrieval-order evidence and does not use the EviGraph operation planner, risk-aware support selection, or verifier-guided repair.
Use this pilot only to decide whether GPT-5.4 is worth scaling to the 300-example Open BM25 setting.
